title: Publish the verified native CaC product prerelease

acceptance_criteria: Installed coherent cac command and generic-only reproducible distribution.
Saved plan binds source and local ownership; stale plans refuse before writes.
Use actual CaC lifecycle, ownership and deployment features during product development, record concrete limitations.
verification: 99 product regressions pass on release source; fresh built-wheel smoke passes all five outcomes.
Prior actual Linux native saved apply and packaged worker evidence retained in productisation.
independent_review: Independent read-only release reviewer confirmed tag/version, prerelease classification, CI gating and coverage claims; no concrete blocker.
rollback_operations: Reinstall prior pinned package and restart controller; source revert requires refreshed lifecycle evidence; retain host state.
